scenarios.title: A｜发现暧昧
scenarios.setting: 玩家无意间看到伴侣和另一个人的聊天内容，明显超过普通朋友的界限。

turns.text: Can we talk about these messages?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: The messages between you and Jamie. They seemed pretty flirtatious.

feedback.naturalExpression: The messages between you and Jamie. They seemed pretty flirtatious.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I saw some of your messages with Jamie, and they made me uncomfortable.

feedback.naturalExpression: I saw some of your messages with Jamie, and they made me uncomfortable.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Some of the things you two were saying didn’t feel appropriate to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Some of the things you two were saying didn’t feel appropriate to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need to know what’s going on between you two.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to know what’s going on between you two.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Who is this person you’re flirting with behind my back?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: The messages between you and Jamie. They seemed pretty flirtatious.
feedback.explanation: 已经带有结论

turns.text: We’re just friends. We joke around like that.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Maybe that’s how you see it, but it crossed a boundary for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe that’s how you see it, but it crossed a boundary for me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Would you be comfortable if I sent messages like that to someone else?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you be comfortable if I sent messages like that to someone else?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not saying you can’t have friends. I’m saying these messages felt romantic to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not saying you can’t have friends. I’m saying these messages felt romantic to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: What exactly is your relationship with her?

feedback.naturalExpression: What exactly is your relationship with her?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: There’s nothing going on between us.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Then I think we need to talk about what we both consider appropriate in a relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: Then I think we need to talk about what we both consider appropriate in a relationship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay, but I still need you to understand why this hurt me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, but I still need you to understand why this hurt me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I want to believe you, but we need to be clear about our boundaries.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to believe you, but we need to be clear about our boundaries.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜发现出轨
scenarios.setting: 玩家已经确认伴侣与另一个人发生了关系。

turns.text: I know about you and Jamie.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I know you’ve been seeing her behind my back.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you’ve been seeing her behind my back.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I found out you’ve been cheating on me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I found out you’ve been cheating on me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I know this wasn’t just friendship. I want you to tell me the truth.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know this wasn’t just friendship. I want you to tell me the truth.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I already know what happened. Please don’t lie to me about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I already know what happened. Please don’t lie to me about it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You’re a liar and a cheater.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I know you’ve been seeing her behind my back.
feedback.explanation: 情绪真实，但无法推进有效对话

turns.text: I was going to tell you. I just didn’t know how.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: How long has this been going on?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long has this been going on?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Was it just once, or has this been happening for a while?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was it just once, or has this been happening for a while?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Did you ever plan to tell me if I hadn’t found out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did you ever plan to tell me if I hadn’t found out?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need you to answer me honestly now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need you to answer me honestly now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: It started a few weeks ago. I’m sorry.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: A few weeks? So you’ve been lying to me this whole time.

feedback.naturalExpression: A few weeks? So you’ve been lying to me this whole time.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t even know what to say right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t even know what to say right now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need some space. I can’t have this conversation right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need some space. I can’t have this conversation right now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need time to decide what this means for our relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need time to decide what this means for our relationship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜质问对方
scenarios.setting: 伴侣试图淡化发生的事情，玩家要求对方正面回答。

turns.text: It didn’t mean anything. It was a mistake.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Whether it meant anything to you or not, you still broke my trust.

feedback.naturalExpression: Whether it meant anything to you or not, you still broke my trust.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Calling it a mistake doesn’t explain why you kept it from me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Calling it a mistake doesn’t explain why you kept it from me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need you to take responsibility for what you did.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need you to take responsibility for what you did.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Please stop minimizing it. This is a serious betrayal for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please stop minimizing it. This is a serious betrayal for me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Don’t give me that excuse.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Whether it meant anything to you or not, you still broke my trust.
feedback.explanation: 很强硬，容易升级争吵

turns.text: I know. I messed up. I don’t want to lose you.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Right now, I don’t know if I can trust you again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Right now, I don’t know if I can trust you again.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I can’t tell you what’s going to happen to us yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t tell you what’s going to happen to us yet.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Saying you’re sorry doesn’t immediately fix what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: Saying you’re sorry doesn’t immediately fix what happened.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need time and space before I decide what I want to do.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need time and space before I decide what I want to do.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Is there anything I can do?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Right now, I need you to give me some space.

feedback.naturalExpression: Right now, I need you to give me some space.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If we’re going to talk about this again, I need complete honesty from you.

feedback.naturalExpression: If we’re going to talk about this again, I need complete honesty from you.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t know yet. I need time to think.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t know yet. I need time to think.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Please don’t pressure me to make a decision tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please don’t pressure me to make a decision tonight.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’ll talk to you when I’m ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll talk to you when I’m ready.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Thank you. I need some time alone right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I need some time alone right now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
